editorial.note: The Common kingfisher ( Alcedo atthis ) is a small, colorful fish-eating bird of the family Alcedinidae , belonging to the genus Alcedo . It is highly skilled at catching fish.
Plum-headed parakeet ( Psittacula cyanocephala ) coming in for landing and feeding on durra ( Sorghum ) in Naogaon, Bangladesh.
